# Nonnina

> Voice companion for older people living alone at home, with real-time family alerts, a relief-amount budget for families, and a marketplace of verified local helpers. One Next.js 15 app (landing + product). Built at the Cursor x Sandbox Founders Hackathon, Stuttgart, 7 Nov 2026. Not an emergency service; never dials 112.

Live: https://www.nonnina.eu (real database, accounts) · https://nonnina-website.vercel.app (demo mode, one-click login)

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, what we built, architecture, how to run
- [docs/judging.md](docs/judging.md): hackathon criteria mapped to evidence
- [docs/validation.md](docs/validation.md): customer, interviews on 7 Nov 2026, what we changed
- [docs/business-model.md](docs/business-model.md): who pays, market, why now, competition

## Code entry points
- app/[locale]/page.tsx: landing page (EN/DE/IT)
- app/(product)/senior/[token]/page.tsx + components/senior/senior-screen.tsx: senior voice screen
- app/(product)/app/page.tsx: family dashboard; components/family/relief-budget-card.tsx
- app/(product)/helpers/: marketplace; lib/marketplace.ts
- app/api/emergency/route.ts, lib/escalation-ladder.ts, lib/notify.ts: emergency flow
- lib/tool-outcomes.ts: what Lina is told after each tool call
- lib/relief-budget.ts: 131 €/month relief amount logic
- lib/db/: store port, Supabase + in-memory adapters, seed
- supabase/migrations/: schema 0001–0007
- tests/: vitest suite
